verdict.rationale: Accounting and ERP sync is a fair question for a business payments account, but the pack documents no first-party ERP or accounting connector, and nothing about real-time bidirectional sync. Statement exports (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF, CSV) and webhook or API primitives are building blocks a developer could use to construct an integration. They are not the sync capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries
